title: Nobody Knows (Yet Again)
summary:
And in many cases, their profit margins aren't high enough to allow them to do so. Higher prices are likely to result in lower unit sales, and thus in declining profit margins. My favorite economist, there's an oxymoron for you, Conrad De Quadros of Breene Capital
considers corporate profit margins to be the best leading indicator of recessions.

reader_summary.headline: On September 15th, 2008, shortly after the close of the New York Stock Exchange.
reader_summary.overview: On September 15th, 2008, shortly after the close of the New York Stock Exchange, Lehman Brother surprised the world by filing for bankruptcy. This came on the heels of rescues slash bankruptcies of bare stirons and marrow lynch. Market participants quickly concluded that the US financial sector was on the verge of melting down.

key_points.evidence_quote: This came on the heels of rescues slash bankruptcies of bare stirons and marrow lynch, and was followed quite soon by more of the same at Wacovia, Washington Mutual, and AIG.

key_points.text: The market's embarked on what felt like a downward spiral without end.
key_points.evidence_quote: The market's embarked on what felt like a downward spiral without end.

key_points.text: I thought I should comment on these developments and the outlook, and the result was a memo called Nobody Knows, published four days later.
key_points.evidence_quote: I thought I should comment on these developments and the outlook, and the result was a memo called Nobody Knows, published four days later.

key_points.text: I affirmed my ignorance of the future, as usual, but to an even greater degree given that all prior expectations had been upended.

thesis: The speaker argues that in times of unprecedented upheaval like the 2008 financial crisis or current trade tensions, there are no facts or prior experiences to base decisions on, and therefore no one can confidently predict the future. Consequently, investors must make decisions in the absence of certainty, recognizing that waiting for clarity or refusing to act is itself a choice that must be scrutinized.
